title: See-Through Minimal 솔로 #063 · super hourglass · 촘촘한 레이스 화이트 · 기대기 · 런웨이 · 오네에갸루
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm golden-brown complexion, mid 30s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, long wavy deep burgundy hair — wearing a minimal two-piece of a tiny bra top of two small cups on thin strings and a micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, both made of densely patterned white floral lace with the flowers closely overlapping and only a fine sheer net showing between them, the material evenly tinted and softly diffusing so her own skin tone glows through it as a gentle blur, the rest of her body bare, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin across her whole body, including where the sheer material veils it, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small mole near her collarbone and a light scatter of faint freckles across her shoulders and upper arms. The tiny garments show real material behaviour: dense lace flowers packed close across the small cups and the tiny triangle, scalloped edges lying flat, the thin strings pressing lightly into her skin. Pose: leaning one arm on a window frame — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, platform stiletto ballet boots made of white leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each as long as her whole hand, in pearl white lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, heavy gold rings on every finger, and a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Indian woman with large almond eyes, strong brows and a defined nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: defined brown-mauve eyeshadow, a precise winged liner, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, softly contoured cheeks, glossy rose-nude lips.

Background: a long white fashion-show runway with a glossy white floor, standard-height steps at the end and softly lit empty rows of seats, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
